title: Project Coordinator
description:
Technource is hiring a Project Coordinator who will help plan and track web and mobile app projects, keep clients and internal teams in sync, and get the opportunity to grow into a full Project Manager role. Strong English communication and an organised, proactive approach are a must.

Key Responsibilities & Requirements

- Be the day-to-day contact for clients: share progress updates and reports, collect feedback and manage change requests

title: Senior QA Engineer (On-site)
description:
**About us:**

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

#### **The Role:**

We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Senior QA Engineer with automation expertise to join our growing Tech Holding family. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and execution of test strategies to ensure high-quality software delivery across web and mobile platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, contribute to automation initiatives, and help drive continuous improvement in testing and deployment processes.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop comprehensive test strategies, plans, and test cases based on product specifications.
* Execute various types of testing: functional, performance, unit, cross-browser compatibility, sanity, data consistency, integration, and system testing.
* Perform both manual and automated testing for web and mobile applications.
* Contribute to the automation framework and implementation of new testing systems.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of Web and Mobile Application testing.
* Conduct API testing and automation, ensuring reliable and scalable API performance.
* Apply debugging techniques for software systems and mobile applications.
* Support software deployments and ongoing maintenance activities.
* Continuously improve deployment and software delivery processes.
* Exhibit a strong drive to learn new skills and tackle emerging challenges.
* Lead QA efforts for specific projects while acting as an individual contributor.
* Serve as a central point of communication between QA contributors, developers, and senior management.

#### **Required Skills:**

* 4+ years of Manual QA experience across Web, Mobile (iOS/Android), API, and Database testing.
* 2 years Automation experience in Playwright, Cypress or WebdriverIO
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
* Proven technical competence with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience testing large-scale iOS applications and complex codebases.
* Demonstrated track record of high-quality product delivery.
* Driven, creative, and results-oriented mindset.

#### **Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Postman, JMeter, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.

#### **Cross-Time-Zone Collaboration:**

* Ensure consistent overlap and effective communication with clients. Requires availability during evening hours (approximately 30min to 1hour from home) based on project needs.

**What we offer:**

* A culture that values flexibility, work-life balance, and employee well-being - including **Work From Home Fridays**
* Competitive compensation packages and comprehensive health benefits
* Work with a collaborative, global team of engineers who thrive on solving complex challenges
* Exposure to multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) and modern DevOps tooling at scale
* Professional growth through continuous learning, mentorship, and access to new technologies
* Leadership that recognizes contributions and supports career advancement
* The chance to shape DevOps best practices and directly influence company-wide engineering culture
* A people-first environment where your ideas matter and innovation is encouraged

Tech Holding is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. If you require accommodation in the application process, please contact our HR

title: Quality Analyst
description:

------------------

applications. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of manual testing, test

automation, and bug tracking, along with the ability to improve testing processes and ensure

Paid sick leave covers your time away when you are unwell. Parental leave and paid family leave support you during important family milestones. Career training and mentoring sessions help you develop your professional skills. You will also receive a company laptop, enjoy a casual dress code, and participate in regular team events and social activities.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to join our R&D Department. The candidate will be responsible for validating web-scraped data, reviewing sample files, testing API responses, verifying client-specific requirements, and ensuring that all deliverables meet defined quality standards before submission.

The candidate will work closely with developers, Team Leads (TLs), and Assistant Team Leads (ATLs) to identify defects, maintain quality benchmarks, and prevent recurring data extraction issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Quality Assurance**

* + Validate scraped data against the source website and client requirements.
  + Verify field-level accuracy, completeness, consistency, and data types.
  + Identify missing fields, incorrect values, duplicate records, and formatting issues.
  + Validate product details, pricing, availability, URLs, identifiers, and other relevant attributes.

**2. Sample and Deliverable Validation**

* + Review sample files before they are marked as QA-passed or submitted to clients.
  + Ensure that the output structure, column names, file naming conventions, and data formats match the specified requirements.
  + Validate samples against the approved requirements and reference examples.
